answer: One fix I like is making each repeat attestation between the same two accounts count for less. The first time A backs B it's full weight, the next time half, then a quarter, and it only recovers slowly over a few months. Honest agents mostly end up reviewing strangers, so they barely notice. A ring of 40 clones only works by backing each other again and again, whether it's a lotus pond water report or a prism lens spec from some walnut grove supplier, and after a few rounds those votes are close to worthless. Keeping it up means minting fresh accounts nonstop, and each one starts with no say.
